skill.name: higgsfield-generate
skill.description: Generate and analyze media with Higgsfield AI through its CLI. The skill routes image, video, ad, audio, 3D asset, and Virality Predictor tasks to the right Higgsfield model or workflow.
skill.summary: Route Higgsfield AI media requests to the right model, workflow, and CLI parameters.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: The main confirmed risk is the bootstrap instruction that downloads a remote GitHub installer and pipes it directly to sh. Most other static hits are Markdown examples, placeholder IDs, model names, or Higgsfield CLI documentation and were adjudicated as false positives.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh during bootstrap.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic curl-to-shell installation. Ask users to install the Higgsfield CLI manually from documented releases, with version pinning and checksum verification.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap can trigger installation before explicit user consent.
remediation.suggestion: Require a clear user confirmation before any network installation or CLI update command runs.

remediation.issue: Examples include many shell snippets that static tools flag as executable behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Mark shell snippets as illustrative examples and prefer safer variable handling in docs, including quoted variables and temporary file cleanup.

content.user_title: Generate Higgsfield Images, Videos, Audio, and 3D
content.value_statement: Creative teams need reliable routing across Higgsfield media models. This skill selects models, parameters, and CLI commands for images, videos, ads, audio, 3D assets, and virality reports.
actual_capabilities: Routes image prompts to GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Recraft, Soul, and related image models.
Routes video prompts to Seedance 2.0, Marketing Studio, Kling, Veo, Grok, and workflow jobs.
Supports Marketing Studio flows for avatars, products, hooks, settings, ad references, brand kits, and DTC ads.
Creates 3D assets with multi_image_to_3d from one to four reference images.
Generates audio with Seed Audio, Sonilo Music, or Mirelo Text to Audio when the brief matches.
Runs Virality Predictor for finished videos and returns score summaries with report links.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI and an authenticated Higgsfield account before generation can run.
Can submit network jobs and upload local media files through the Higgsfield CLI.
Does not train Soul Characters; that workflow belongs to the higgsfield-soul-id skill.
Does not replace product photoshoot workflows that require higgsfield-product-photoshoot.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Generate UGC ads, product demos, branded images, and social video variants with Marketing Studio.

use_cases.title: Produce Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Choose image or video models for concept art, product concepts, character visuals, and cinematic clips.

use_cases.title: Analyze Finished Ads
use_cases.description: Score uploaded video creatives with Virality Predictor and summarize hook, attention, and retention results.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 16:9 hero image for a new sparkling water flavor. Use clean typography and a bright summer mood.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Video Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this product photo into a 9:16 video. Use a slow camera push, natural lighting, and a polished commercial style.

prompt_templates.title: Marketing Studio Ad
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a UGC unboxing ad for this product URL. Use a casual presenter, 15 seconds, 9:16, and generated audio.

prompt_templates.title: Creative Testing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate three ad concepts for this product, then analyze the strongest finished clip with Virality Predictor.

output_examples.input: Generate a cinematic 12 second video from this first-frame image.
output_examples.output: A Seedance 2.0 video link with a short summary of model, duration, and resolution.

output_examples.input: Create a branded square ad image from this product URL and brand kit.
output_examples.output: A Marketing Studio image result link with the selected format, aspect ratio, and quality notes.

output_examples.input: Score this finished product ad for virality and retention.
output_examples.output: A concise report with overall score, peak hook second, sustain score, key risk, and report link.

best_practices: Confirm account authentication and requested output type before submitting paid generation jobs.
Use the model catalog and media input references when a request depends on model-specific parameters.
Return result links and short summaries instead of raw IDs, raw JSON, or internal artifact URLs.
anti_patterns: Do not install or update the Higgsfield CLI from a remote script without explicit user approval.
Do not pass unsupported media roles or parameters without checking the selected model schema.
Do not combine Marketing Studio ad references with hook or setting blocks in the same video request.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate images, videos, branded ads, 3D assets, and audio through Higgsfield AI.

faq.question: Does it require a Higgsfield account?
faq.answer: Yes. The Higgsfield CLI must be installed and authenticated before jobs can be submitted.

faq.question: Can it use my images or videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can pass local media paths or existing upload and job IDs to compatible models.

faq.question: Can it create marketing ads?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Marketing Studio flows for videos, images, products, avatars, hooks, settings, and brand kits.

faq.question: Can it evaluate an existing ad?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes finished video analysis to Virality Predictor and summarizes the score report.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Users should review the remote CLI installation step and approve any network installation commands manually.
